cover.title: How Does a Free App Make $1B?
cover.label: FY2025

lines.text: In 2025, Duolingo's free app made over $1 billion.
lines.say: In twenty twenty-five, Duolingo's free app made over a billion dollars.

lines.text: Yet as of June 2026, just 12.7 million of its 140.6 million monthly users paid. About 9%.
lines.say: Yet as of June twenty twenty-six, just twelve point seven million of its one hundred forty point six million monthly users paid. That's about nine percent.

lines.text: Still, Duolingo reports revenue grew from $161.7 million in 2020 to $1.04 billion in 2025.
lines.say: Still, Duolingo reports revenue grew from about one hundred sixty-two million dollars in twenty twenty to about one point oh four billion in twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: The secret: in 2025, subscriptions brought in $873.4 million, about 84%. Ads brought in $79.7 million.
lines.say: The secret? In twenty twenty-five, subscriptions brought in eight hundred seventy-three point four million dollars, about eighty-four percent. Ads brought in seventy-nine point seven million.

lines.text: So the free users aren't really the product. The paying ones are.
lines.say: So the free users mostly aren't paying the bills. The subscribers are.

lines.text: The rest in 2025: the Duolingo English Test made $42.0 million, and in-app purchases $40.5 million.
lines.say: The rest in twenty twenty-five came from the Duolingo English Test, at forty-two million, and in-app purchases, at forty point five million.

lines.text: Free users get lessons with ads. Super drops the ads and limits. Max adds AI features for more.
lines.say: Free users get the lessons with ads. Super drops the ads and limits, and Max adds A I features for a higher price.

lines.text: Hypothetical: 1,000,000 users x 9% = 90,000 payers. At $60 a year, that's $5.4 million.
lines.say: Here's a hypothetical: a million users times nine percent is ninety thousand payers. At sixty dollars a year each, that's five point four million dollars.

lines.text: The other 910,000 pay nothing. A small paying slice funds the free app for everyone else.
lines.say: The other nine hundred ten thousand pay nothing. A small paying slice funds the free app for everyone else.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.
lines.say: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: How does a free app make $1B? Duolingo's 2025 numbers
post.ig:
In 2025, Duolingo's free app made over $1 billion ($1,037.6M).

As of June 2026, 12.7M of its 140.6M monthly users paid, about 9%.
Subscriptions brought in $873.4M in 2025 (about 84%). Ads: $79.7M. Duolingo English Test: $42.0M. In-app purchases: $40.5M.
Revenue grew from $161.7M in 2020 to $1.04B in 2025.
Hypothetical: 1,000,000 users x 9% = 90,000 payers; at $60/yr that's $5.4M.

Sources: Duolingo FY2025 Form 10-K; Duolingo Q2 2026 shareholder letter (Aug 2026).
